comment: Sailing objectives and renown balancing (Iteration 006). Rewards are renown points. Types: voyage_count, total_distance, visit_harbour, visit_count, passage_length, clean_passage, weather_arrival, new_harbour, and for the captain's hat (Visual Identity V01) hat_lost_count, hat_spent (euros), hat_lost_soon (game minutes after buying), hat_weather_voyage (hazard), original_hat_voyages, hat_lost_offshore (nm of open water all round). Since I024 (The Company We Keep) an objective with retired = true is filler retired from the achievement collection (achievements.json) and from the Log's list of goals; it still pays its renown as a small renown event, so balance and saves are unchanged. 'repeatable' objectives pay once per qualifying voyage; the others once. 'secret' ones stay hidden in the Captain's Log (title, condition and reward) until found; 'tone' is proud or comic.

objectives.title: Cast off
objectives.text: Complete your first voyage: sail from one harbour to another and moor there.

objectives.title: Across the Western Baltic
objectives.text: Sail to Kiel and moor there.

objectives.title: The first hundred miles
objectives.text: Sail 100 nautical miles in all.

objectives.title: New horizons
objectives.text: Moor in a harbour you have never visited before. Paid for every new harbour.

objectives.title: Harbour hopper
objectives.text: Visit 5 different harbours (your start harbour counts).

objectives.title: Well travelled
objectives.text: Visit 10 different harbours.

objectives.title: Regular passages
objectives.text: Complete 5 voyages.

objectives.title: A thousand miles
objectives.text: Sail 1,000 nautical miles in all.

objectives.title: Offshore passage
objectives.text: Complete a single passage of at least 200 nm.

objectives.title: Long haul
objectives.text: Complete a single passage of at least 500 nm.

objectives.title: Blue-water passage
objectives.text: Complete a passage of at least 300 nm. Paid for every such passage.

objectives.title: Not a scratch
objectives.text: Complete a passage of at least 150 nm without any damage to the boat.

objectives.title: Heavy weather
objectives.text: Arrive safely after sailing through dangerous or severe weather.

objectives.title: Captain No-Hat
objectives.text: The sea has claimed its most important trophy.

objectives.title: Hat Trick
objectives.text: Three captain's hats lost to the wind. The gulls have started a collection.

objectives.title: Hold Onto Your Hat
objectives.text: Sailed through dangerous weather with your hat on deck, and arrived still owning it.

objectives.title: The Hat Tax
objectives.text: Spent €100 on replacement captain's hats. The grocer knows you by name.

objectives.title: The Last Straw
objectives.text: Lost a brand-new captain's hat within five minutes of buying it.

objectives.title: A Captain of Distinction
objectives.text: Ten voyages completed without ever losing your original captain's hat.

objectives.title: The Sea Wears a Hat Now
objectives.text: Lost a captain's hat at sea with no land within 20 nm. It suits the ocean.

generated.comment: Distant harbours worth a visit, chosen from the harbour catalogue: those at least min_nm (great circle) from the start harbour, evenly spread by distance; the reward grows with distance between min_reward and max_reward.
